violations.text: The fish case is lacking a consumer advisory warning. Consumer advisory must be posted at fish case. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
Food items for sale grab and go muffins do not have posted ingredients. Establishment must post ingredients on label. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back receiving area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Opened Deli Meat packages was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2024

The condensate from the ice cream freezer refrigeration was observed with an excess of ice build up. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2024
The tile coving by in the bakery by the walk in freezer is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2025
